relationships.evidence_quote: activate the NRF2/SIRT3/SOD2 pathway to inhibit the production of ROS

relationships.subject: mitochondrial ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibit the production of ROS, which will further inhibit the M1 macrophage polarization

key_findings: Low-protein diet alleviated K/BxN arthritis and shifted synovial macrophages from M1 to M2.
Effect depends on NRF2/SIRT3/SOD2 reducing mitochondrial ROS; NRF2 knockdown abolished it.
